payload.text:
init's normalisation is graded against population 3 (Rust init + Rust build), labelled as such, never against population 2.
THIS ROW ASSUMES A CAPABILITY THAT DOES NOT EXIST AND THAT AC-2.1'S DISCHARGE WILL NOT CREATE. Found by vc 2026-09-09 18:20Z, before either row was graded and before cc's first build. THE TRAP IS ALREADY ARMED: design.md 4.1 calls population (2) "the one that happens by accident -- the masters are on disk and nobody re-runs `init`", and the 45h reel's assets ARE those masters, measured at 2560 pixels wide, which is exactly what `normalise_image` writes. So cc's first Rust build over 45h is population (2) BY CONSTRUCTION, not (3). WHAT THE HARNESS CAN AND CANNOT DERIVE, READ AT SOURCE: `population_source` is `"stamp" if stamp else "adjacency (UNVERIFIED)"` where `stamp = producer_stamp(artifact)`, so it answers WHICH COMPILER BUILT THE ARTIFACT. `label` is `args.label or "unlabelled"` -- CALLER-SUPPLIED, which is precisely the "flag someone passed" design.md 4.1 forbids deriving a population from. No other manifest key touches init: label, artifact, artifact_sha256, population_source, producer, compiler_adjacent, compiler_adjacent_sha256, chrome, viewport, host, slide_count, captured, budgets, retries, signature, captured_at. SO THE DERIVATION COVERS THE BUILD HALF AND NOTHING COVERS THE INIT HALF -- and the init half is the ENTIRE difference between (2) and (3). The mechanism built to stop "a run of (2) reported as (3)" does not reach the distinction it exists for. AC-2.1 DOES NOT CLOSE THIS AND IT IS WORTH SAYING WHY: its three legs are artifact-level population, producer-level population, and the refusal, and all three are about the artifact and its builder. Even once WP-03 stamps the build and leg 2 becomes a derivation, the harness still will not know whether the masters came from Python init or Rust init. THE FIX SHAPE, NOT PRESCRIBED: Rust `init` stamps its masters the way the Rust build stamps its artifact, at which point (3) is provable and the ABSENCE of that stamp derives (2) -- exactly as the absence of a producer stamp already derives "adjacency (UNVERIFIED)". That keeps it a derivation rather than a flag. THIS IS THE SAME SHAPE AS AC-2.1'S LEG 2 ONE WORK PACKAGE LATER: that row records a real WP-02-on-WP-03 dependency so it is not rediscovered as a surprise, and this is a WP-02-on-WP-04 dependency recorded for the same reason. Until Rust init exists, EVERY run is population (2) and this row cannot be satisfied by any of them.
vc'S DIMENSION EVIDENCE WAS SAMPLED RATHER THAN MEASURED, CORRECTED BY snorkeltoast 2026-09-09, AND THE CORRECTION STRENGTHENS THE CONCLUSION. vc ran `find | head -4`, saw four assets at 2560, and wrote "the reel's assets ARE those masters" -- FOUR MEMBERS CHARACTERISING A SET OF NINE, which is the rule cc's own board leads with. Re-measured over the whole population with the partition printed: NINE raster assets, SIX at the 2560 cap and THREE below it (1024, 1433, 1920), and the partition sums. AND THE INFERENCE RUNS ONLY ONE WAY, which is snorkeltoast's point: `normalise_image` resizes only `if max(w, h) > max_edge`, so a file AT the cap was resized to reach it and IS evidence, while a file BELOW the cap was either normalised and already small or never touched, and those two are indistinguishable. So 6-and-3 is not a ratio and must not be read as one. A REFINEMENT THE DIRECTORY GIVES AND THE DIMENSION DOES NOT: all six at the cap are in `art/`, and all three below are in `brand/` and `location/` -- buckets init NEVER CREATES, since design.md 4.1 records that init writes exactly `titles`, `art`, `photos`, `cards`. So in this reel the three are not ambiguous evidence, they are a different INPUT CLASS, and the six that are init's own bucket are six of six at the cap. THE SHARPER POINT, AND IT IS WHY THE STAMP IS THE ONLY MECHANISM RATHER THAN THE NEATEST ONE: a Rust init will cap at the SAME 2560, so the dimension is identical under either init and cannot separate (2) from (3) EVEN IN PRINCIPLE. Disk can establish THAT normalisation happened and can never establish WHO did it. That closes off reading the masters more cleverly, which was the alternative snorkeltoast says they would otherwise have proposed, and leaves the stamp standing alone. WHAT LANDED WITHOUT WAITING ON cc (snorkeltoast 7f8454c): compare's POPULATION block used to print a source line covering the build half while implying nothing about init, which READS AS COMPLETENESS. It now derives what disk supports and refuses the rest BY NAME -- reporting the master counts, stating that an init has run, and then saying that WHICH init is not established and cannot be from disk, naming this as design.md 4.1's population (2). So the first compare after cc's build will say in the run that it does not know, rather than being labelled in a way nobody can defend.
THE BUCKET SPLIT LANDED AT b5e4365 AND snorkeltoast FOUND A FAULT IN THEIR OWN LINE WHILE BUILDING IT. `INIT_BUCKETS = {"titles","art","photos","cards"}` is ONE definition with a second READER rather than a second list -- the master derivation and `partition()` both read it -- and the split happens before anything is counted, because a dimension is only evidence about a file init would have written. THE FAULT WAS A CAVEAT PRINTED UNCONDITIONALLY: "a file below the cap is not evidence either way" fired on every run, and on this reel there are ZERO files below the cap inside init's buckets, so it was a warning about a population that does not exist here. snorkeltoast's own words for why that matters: **a caveat nobody reads is worse than no caveat, because it still looks like diligence.** Now guarded on `if norm["below"]`, and verified by vc at source: on 45h it correctly does not print, while the line that IS true of every reel -- which init is not established and cannot be from disk -- correctly still does. RED-PROVED ON CONSTRUCTED REELS BECAUSE 45h CAN NO LONGER REACH EITHER BRANCH, which snorkeltoast names as the same problem as grading a detector on the one config everybody runs: a mixed reel gives at_cap 1 / below 1 / outside 1, and a reel whose only master is under the cap gives at_cap 0, where the harness says there is NO evidence init ran rather than claiming it did -- the branch most worth seeing fire, since a wrong answer there would be an invented population rather than a missing caveat.
